title: Ypres Cloth Hall
geometryBasis: Native named footprints and two courtyard holes, the public-domain original market facade, and the Flemish heritage inventory exterior and section description.
sectionBasis: The elongated two-story sandstone hall fronts the marketplace on either side of the 70 m belfry. Four tall corner pinnacles bracket the belfry's slate spire. The attached Nieuwerck has a separate Renaissance front and open lower passage.
limitations: The original view and heritage description establish the market elevation, while smaller roof and courtyard details are approximated.
The adjacent cathedral and surrounding market buildings are outside the modeled building scope.
